name: OnFRA — Onchain Financial Intelligence Agent
description: OnFRA turns Celo wallet activity into structured financial intelligence for people and AI agents: wallet profiles, cash flow, token balances and breakdowns, spending, counterparties, activity, period comparisons, transaction explanations and downloadable statements. Most tools are free; explain_transaction (0.02 USDT) and generate_transaction_statement (0.01 USDT) are paid via x402 for agents and API clients. Available at https://app.onfra.xyz. ERC-8004 agent #9219.

x402.enforcement: Agents and API clients pay via x402 for generate_transaction_statement, explain_transaction (generate_transaction_statement: 0.01 USDT, explain_transaction: 0.02 USDT). All other tools are free with fair-use rate limits. Everything is free inside the OnFRA app. Discovery endpoints (capabilities, x402 config, health) are free. Unpaid calls to paid tools return HTTP 402 with machine-readable accepts[].

pricing.model: free tools plus pay-per-request for two tools
pricing.in_app: Free inside the OnFRA app at app.onfra.xyz (rate limited). Agents and API clients pay the listed price via x402.
pricing.chat_query: 0.01 USDT for external wallets; free for the caller's own wallet in the app.

paymentRequiredBody.retry: Sign EIP-3009 USDT auth for accepts[0].maxAmountRequired to accepts[0].payTo, then resubmit with X-PAYMENT

onChainActions.name: USDT x402 settlement
onChainActions.description: Paid tool calls settle on Celo mainnet in USDT to the OnFRA treasury (payTo from /api/x402/config or /api/health/integrations).

onChainActions.name: Call trace purchase through Buy
onChainActions.description: For swaps, contract calls and failed transactions, explain_transaction buys one Chainstack Celo RPC request ($0.01 USD, x402 on Celo) through the Buy gateway to fetch a call trace, and returns the settlement transaction in purchases[]. Simple transfers need no purchase.

onChainActions.name: ERC-8004 agent identity
onChainActions.description: OnFRA is registered as ERC-8004 agent #9219 on the Celo mainnet Identity Registry.
onChainActions.note: Identity and reputation registries are onchain; analysis itself reads public Celo wallet history (off-chain compute).

tee.note: Agent runs on Vercel serverless at app.onfra.xyz.

skills.name: Analyze Wallet
skills.description: Flagship tool. Returns a structured financial intelligence profile of a wallet: overview, financial summary, token overview, activity level, insights and data quality. Observed data, calculated metrics, classifications and insights are kept separate.

skills.name: Get Cash Flow Summary
skills.description: Total inflow, outflow and net flow for a period, with transaction counts, daily averages and trend. Internal transfers, swaps, self-transfers, gas and failed transactions are handled explicitly and reported in data_quality.

skills.name: Get Token Balances
skills.description: Current token holdings with normalized token identification and USD valuation. Clean data retrieval with spam filtering.

skills.name: Get Token Breakdown
skills.description: How a wallet's financial activity is distributed across tokens, by balance, received, sent or volume. Balances and historical volume are separate measurements and are never mixed.

skills.name: Generate Transaction Statement
skills.description: Generates a period-based PDF or CSV statement, pins it to IPFS and returns the reference (CID, ipfs:// URI and HTTPS gateway URL) with a summary. The CID is only returned after the upload is verified.
skills.pricing: 0.01 USDT via x402 for agents and API clients; free in the app

skills.name: Compare Periods
skills.description: Compares financial activity between two equivalent time windows: inflow, outflow, net flow and transaction count, with percentage change and insights. Incomplete windows are flagged, never silently compared.

skills.name: Explain Transaction
skills.description: Explains what happened in a specific transaction in plain language: type, amounts, parties, gas, classification with confidence, and warnings. Handles transfers, swaps, contract calls, liquidity, NFTs, bridges and failed transactions. States uncertainty rather than inventing a purpose.
skills.pricing: 0.02 USDT via x402 for agents and API clients; free in the app

skills.name: Get Spending Breakdown
skills.description: Where a wallet's outgoing money went, grouped by token, counterparty, protocol or category. Classifications carry confidence levels, with an unknown category where the purpose cannot be identified.

skills.name: Get Dominant Counterparties
skills.description: Ranks the addresses and entities a wallet interacts with most, by volume or frequency, with labels where known (exchanges, protocols) and interaction direction.

skills.name: Get Wallet Activity
skills.description: How active a wallet is, independent of its financial value: transaction count, active days, first and last activity, and activity pattern (frequency and trend).
